title: Protein Crystallization Segmentation and Classification Using Subordinate Color Channel in Fluorescence Microscopy Images
abstract: arXiv:2610.15286v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The accuracy of detecting protein crystals for fluorescence microscopy images is very critical for high throughput and automated systems. Although the trace fluorescent labeling method could highlight protein crystals, reflection and emission from the fluorescence dye is not always due to crystal regions. Therefore, the analysis of the peak wavelength in the emission spectra of a fluorophore may not always yield effective results. In this paper, we show that using the subordinate color intensity corresponding to longer wavelengths than the peak wavelength of the emission spectra could improve the accuracy of protein crystal detection. Hence, we have built a segmentation method based on the percentile intensity of the subordinate color for trace fluorescently labeled (TFL'd) protein crystallization trial images. translated_title: 基于荧光显微镜图像中从属颜色通道的蛋白质结晶分割与分类
translated_abstract: 荧光显微镜图像中蛋白质晶体检测的准确性对于高通量和自动化系统至关重要。尽管微量荧光标记方法可以突出显示蛋白质晶体，但荧光染料的反射和发射并不总是来自晶体区域。因此，分析荧光团发射光谱中的峰值波长可能并不总是能产生有效的结果。在本文中，我们证明了使用对应于发射光谱峰值波长更长波长的从属颜色强度可以提高蛋白质晶体检测的准确性。因此，我们针对微量荧光标记（TFL）的蛋白质结晶试验图像，构建了一种基于从属颜色百分位强度的分割方法。与使用主导颜色通道相比，我们在从属颜色通道上的分割方法能够减少误检……（原文摘要到此被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出利用发射光谱中比峰值波长更长的从属颜色通道强度对微量荧光标记的蛋白质结晶图像进行分割，相比传统的主导颜色通道方法能够显著提高蛋白质晶体检测的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using the subordinate color channel intensity (corresponding to wavelengths longer than the emission spectra peak) to segment trace fluorescently labeled protein crystallization images, which improves protein crystal detection accuracy compared to using the dominant color channel.
